sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Enables database extensions
sections.what: Turns on UUID support, encryption functions, fuzzy text search, and vector storage.
sections.why: The database features the app uses depend on these extensions.
sections.watch_out: Vector support needs the pgvector image named in the compose file.

summary: Database setup script that turns on four Postgres extensions for the local database.
purpose: Enables UUID generation, encryption functions, fuzzy text search, and vector storage.
why: The comments say fuzzy search and vector embeddings are for retrieval. The reasons for UUIDs and encryption are not stated in the code.
how: Runs once when the Postgres container first creates its data. Each extension is created only if it does not already exist.
inputs: Nothing from the app. It runs inside Postgres.
risks: It runs only on a fresh data volume, so changes do not reach existing databases.
debug: If vector or UUID functions are missing, confirm the container started with a fresh volume and read its initialization logs.
